tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (12.8:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Tuscan clay, warm earth, Siena palette. Used as text on `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`, `.stat-value`. 3.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: terracotta-deep
tokens.usage: Aged brick, Florentine rooftops. Used as text on `.page-title`, `.table-header`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: terracotta-light
tokens.usage: Fresco pink, delicate warmth.

tokens.name: gold-renaissance
tokens.usage: Gilded frames, illuminated manuscripts. Used as shadow/glow on `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Old master varnish, aged gold leaf. Used as text on `.btn-secondary`. 3.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: forest-green
tokens.usage: Cypress trees, garden grottos. Used as text on `.nav a`, `.stat-label`, `.card-content`. 8.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: forest-sage
tokens.usage: Olive groves, Renaissance gardens. Used as text on `.subtitle`. 4.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Canvas, parchment, marble statuary. Used as text on `th`, `.footer`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Fresco plaster, aged paper.

tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: Oil paint shadows, walnut frames. Used as text on `body`, `.header h1`, `.card-title`. 12.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
